_what: How edits of one recording are kept as versions beside the untouched original (media-versions.mjs). Every edit is rendered as a NEW version from the original; the original is version 1 and is never changed. `min_gap_seconds` is the shortest time between two publishes of one recording, `min_seconds` the shortest edit worth publishing. `words` say each refusal in plain words.

words.RENDERING: A version of this recording is still being made. Wait for it to finish, then publish again.
words.PUBLISHING: Another version of this recording is being published. Wait for it to finish.
words.TOO_SOON: A version of this recording was published a moment ago. Wait {wait_seconds} seconds, then publish again.
words.TOO_SHORT: This edit is shorter than {min_seconds} seconds, which is too short to publish.
words.DUPLICATE: A version with the id "{id}" already exists.
words.ORIGINAL: The original is kept as it was made and cannot be removed.
words.DEFAULT: This is the version people see by default. Choose another default first.
